#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>

using namespace std;

class G {
public:
    void execute() {
        ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
        cin.tie(0);
        
        int n, m, k, c, d;
        cin >> n >> m >> k >> c >> d;

        int maxl = n + k;
        int T = n * maxl + 1;
        MinCostMaxFlow ans(T + 1, 0, T);
        
        vector<int> a(k + 1);
        vector<int> f(n + 1, 0);
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
            cin >> a[i];
            f[a[i]]++;
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            if (f[i] == 0) continue;
            ans.addEdge(0, i, f[i], 0);
        }
        
        for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int l = 0; l < maxl - 1; l++) {
                ans.addEdge(l * n + i, (l + 1) * n + i, k, c);
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            int u, v;
            cin >> u >> v;
            for (int l = 0; l < maxl - 1; l++) {
                for (int p = 1; p <= k; p++) {
                    if (u != 1)
                        ans.addEdge(n * l + u, n * (l + 1) + v, 1, d * (2 * p - 1) + c);
                    if (v != 1)
                        ans.addEdge(n * l + v, n * (l + 1) + u, 1, d * (2 * p - 1) + c);
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int l = 1; l < maxl; l++) {
            ans.addEdge(l * n + 1, T, k, 0);
        }
        
        ans.convertToArray();
        ans.calWithPotential();

        if (ans.maxFlow != k) {
            cout << "BUG" << endl;
        } else {
            cout << ans.minCost << endl;
        }
    }

    class TaskE {
    public:
        class Edge {
        public:
            int u, flow, rid, cost;
            Edge(int a, int b, int c, int d) : u(a), flow(b), cost(c), rid(d) {}
        };

        class MinCostMaxFlow {
        public:
            vector<vector<Edge>> al;
            vector<vector<Edge>> ja;
            vector<int> d;
            int N, S, T, maxFlow, minCost;
            const int INF = INT_MAX / 100;

            MinCostMaxFlow(int n, int source, int sink) {
                N = n;
                S = source;
                T = sink;
                maxFlow = 0;
                minCost = 0;
                al.resize(N);
                d.resize(N);
            }

            void addEdge(int u, int v, int flow, int cost) {
                int lu = al[u].size(), lv = al[v].size();
                al[u].push_back(Edge(v, flow, cost, lv));
                al[v].push_back(Edge(u, 0, -cost, lu));
            }

            void convertToArray() {
                ja.resize(N);
                for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                    int sz = al[i].size();
                    ja[i].resize(sz);
                    for (int j = 0; j < sz; j++) {
                        ja[i][j] = al[i][j];
                    }
                    al[i].clear();
                }
            }

            bool BellmanFord(bool check) {
                fill(d.begin(), d.end(), INF);
                d[S] = 0;
                for (int i = 0; i < N - 1; i++) {
                    for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                        for (const Edge& e : ja[j]) {
                            if (e.flow == 0) continue;
                            if (d[j] != INF && d[e.u] > d[j] + e.cost) {
                                d[e.u] = d[j] + e.cost;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (check) {
                    for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                        for (const Edge& e : ja[j]) {
                            if (e.flow == 0) continue;
                            if (d[j] != INF && d[j] + e.cost < d[e.u]) return false;
                        }
                    }
                }
                return true;
            }

            vector<int> node, visit, prv, prve, dist;

            bool simple() {
                node.resize(N);
                visit.resize(N, 0);
                prv.resize(N);
                prve.resize(N);
                dist.resize(N);
                fill(dist.begin(), dist.end(), INF);

                node[0] = S;
                dist[S] = 0;
                int front = 1, back = 0;
                while (front != back) {
                    int u = node[back++];
                    if (back == N) back = 0;
                    visit[u] = 2;
                    for (int i = 0; i < (int)ja[u].size(); i++) {
                        Edge e = ja[u][i];
                        if (e.flow == 0) continue;
                        int cdist = dist[u] + e.cost;
                        if (cdist < dist[e.u]) {
                            if (visit[e.u] == 0) {
                                node[front] = e.u;
                                if (++front == N) front = 0;
                            } else if (visit[e.u] == 2) {
                                if (--back == -1) back += N;
                                node[back] = e.u;
                            }
                            visit[e.u] = 1;
                            prve[e.u] = i;
                            prv[e.u] = u;
                            dist[e.u] = cdist;
                        }
                    }
                }
                return visit[T] != 0;
            }

            struct Pair {
                int F, S;
                Pair(int a, int b) : F(a), S(b) {}
                bool operator<(const Pair& other) const {
                    return S > other.S;
                }
            };

            bool dijkstra() {
                visit.resize(N, 0);
                prv.resize(N);
                prve.resize(N);
                dist.resize(N);
                fill(dist.begin(), dist.end(), INF);
                priority_queue<Pair> pq;

                pq.push(Pair(S, 0));
                dist[S] = 0;
                while (!pq.empty()) {
                    Pair p = pq.top();
                    pq.pop();
                    while (dist[p.F] < p.S) {
                        if (pq.empty()) return false;
                        pq.pop();
                    }
                    visit[p.F] = 2;
                    for (int i = 0; i < (int)ja[p.F].size(); i++) {
                        Edge e = ja[p.F][i];
                        if (e.flow == 0) continue;
                        int cdist = p.S + (e.cost + d[p.F] - d[e.u]);
                        if (cdist < dist[e.u]) {
                            if (visit[e.u] == 2) return false;
                            pq.push(Pair(e.u, cdist));
                            dist[e.u] = cdist;
                            prv[e.u] = p.F;
                            prve[e.u] = i;
                            visit[e.u] = 1;
                        }
                    }
                }
                return visit[T] != 0;
            }

            int augment() {
                int p = T;
                int minFlow = INF;
                while (p != S) {
                    int pp = prv[p], pe = prve[p];
                    int val = ja[pp][pe].flow;
                    minFlow = min(minFlow, val);
                    p = pp;
                }
                p = T;
                while (p != S) {
                    int pp = prv[p], pe = prve[p];
                    ja[pp][pe].flow -= minFlow;
                    ja[p][ja[pp][pe].rid].flow += minFlow;
                    p = pp;
                }
                maxFlow += minFlow;
                return minFlow;
            }

            bool calSimple() {
                while (simple()) {
                    minCost += dist[T] * augment();
                }
                return true;
            }

            void updPotential() {
                for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                    if (visit[i] != 0) {
                        d[i] += dist[i] - dist[S];
                    }
                }
            }

            bool calWithPotential() {
                while (dijkstra()) {
                    int minCostVal = dist[T] + d[T] - d[S];
                    minCost += minCostVal * augment();
                    updPotential();
                }
                return true;
            }
        };

        void process(int testNumber, istream& in, ostream& out) {
            int n, m, k, c, d;
            in >> n >> m >> k >> c >> d;

            int maxl = n + k;
            int T = n * maxl + 1;
            MinCostMaxFlow ans(T + 1, 0, T);
            vector<int> a(k + 1);
            vector<int> f(n + 1, 0);
            
            for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
                in >> a[i];
                f[a[i]]++;
            }
            
            for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                if (f[i] == 0) continue;
                ans.addEdge(0, i, f[i], 0);
            }
            
            for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
                for (int l = 0; l < maxl - 1; l++) {
                    ans.addEdge(l * n + i, (l + 1) * n + i, k, c);
                }
            }
            
            for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
                int u, v;
                in >> u >> v;
                for (int l = 0; l < maxl - 1; l++) {
                    for (int p = 1; p <= k; p++) {
                        if (u != 1)
                            ans.addEdge(n * l + u, n * (l + 1) + v, 1, d * (2 * p - 1) + c);
                        if (v != 1)
                            ans.addEdge(n * l + v, n * (l + 1) + u, 1, d * (2 * p - 1) + c);
                    }
                }
            }
            
            for (int l = 1; l < maxl; l++) {
                ans.addEdge(l * n + 1, T, k, 0);
            }
            
            ans.convertToArray();
            ans.calWithPotential();

            if (ans.maxFlow != k) {
                out << "BUG" << endl;
            } else {
                out << ans.minCost << endl;
            }
        }
    };
};

int main() {
    G g;
    g.execute();
    return 0;
}
